# Base Note Data

> Base Note Data is a boutique marketing measurement consultancy founded by Chelsea Cramer and based in Brooklyn, NY. It helps marketing and growth teams understand what their spend is actually driving, using marketing mix modeling (MMM), incrementality testing, geo experiments, multi-touch attribution, and causal inference.

Base Note Data (basenotedata.com) is a marketing analytics consultancy. It is not affiliated with Basenotes, the fragrance community.

## About

- [About Chelsea Cramer](https://basenotedata.com/#about): Independent marketing measurement and analytics consultant based in New York and founder of Base Note Data, with 13+ years in marketing analytics across fintech, health/wellness, and B2B. Built TV measurement and MMM programs at Credit Karma, where she unified media measurement as budget scaled from $100M to $300M while ROI improved. Currently consults for brands including Robinhood. Previously Director of Marketing Analytics at Gympass/Wellhub, its first marketing analytics hire.

## Services

- [Marketing mix modeling consultant](https://basenotedata.com/marketing-mix-modeling): Independent MMM (media mix modeling) consulting from Chelsea Cramer. Building and calibrating MMMs that finance and marketing both trust, and turning them into budget decisions.
- [Incrementality testing consultant](https://basenotedata.com/incrementality-testing): Independent incrementality testing consulting from Chelsea Cramer. Designing and reading holdout, geo-lift, and RCT tests to measure true lift by channel.
- [AI marketing consultant](https://basenotedata.com/ai-marketing-consultant): Chelsea Cramer helps marketing teams build AI workflows and marketing automation into their analytics, including AI anomaly detection and data-ingestion alerts in Slack (built for a fintech brand spending $100M a year on marketing), automated weekly and monthly reporting, templated test plans and power analysis, and automated lead-scouting workflows for B2B clients.
- [Attribution](https://basenotedata.com/#work): Auditing and improving multi-touch attribution, and reconciling it with MMM and experiment results.
- [Causal inference](https://basenotedata.com/#work): Diff-in-diff, synthetic controls, and other quasi-experimental methods for when a clean test isn't possible.

## Speaking

- [Speaking](https://basenotedata.com/speaking): Chelsea Cramer's talks and podcast appearances on marketing measurement, including "Can you build your own MMM?" at Advertising Week New York (Oct 2026), "Align brand investment with executive priorities" at BERA.ai Measurement Playbook Day (Sep 2026), and the Growth Talks podcast by Right Side Up (Jul 2024).
- [Analyst training](https://basenotedata.com/speaking#training): Data presentation workshops from New York City-based Chelsea Cramer for agency and in-house analyst teams, covering leading with the answer, one-point charts, tailoring a story to clients, CMOs and CFOs, and handling pushback. Formats: 2-hour team workshop, half-day hands-on deck session, and ongoing deck reviews. In person in New York City or virtual.

## Tools

- [Is your marketing measurement best-in-class? (quiz)](https://basenotedata.com/best-in-class-quiz): A free nine-question self-assessment that places a brand on a five-stage path to best-in-class marketing measurement (Platform-Reliant, Attribution-Led, Experimenting, Triangulated, Best-in-Class), scores methods, budget decisions, and data foundations, and recommends three next steps.
